title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 50 mm wingspan · black base with the red hat and white trim on top · hangs from a tiny hole in the pom-pom, shown as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 50 mm wing tip to wing tip (your pick). The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes_title: v9: what changed, what to check
notes: v9: the white brim and pom-pom are now raised: 1 mm of white on the black base, so they stand 0.4 mm above the red hat. Their top edges are rounded (0.35 mm radius), including around the hanging hole, so they look soft and puffy. The texture (tufts up to 0.3 mm) is on top, and fades out before the rounded edge so the edge stays clean. Still no extra colour changes: only white prints above the red. Tip: print the top 1.3 mm at 0.1 mm layers (Bambu Studio height range modifier from 2.0 mm) so the rounded edge and texture come out smooth.
